headline: Red Flag?
caption:
Sean O'Malley says Petr Yan's back surgery changes how he sees Yan's title defense against Merab Dvalishvili.
Worried for Yan or no? 👇

O'Malley told coach Tim Welch his biggest regret was fighting months after his own surgery. Yan vs. Dvalishvili 3 for the UFC bantamweight title co-headlines UFC 333 in Abu Dhabi Saturday.

🔥 Hot take: Ring rust after surgery is real, and Yan has to prove he's past it Saturday.
Disagree? Tell me why you're wrong.
question: Worried for Yan?

v2.story: O'Malley says Yan's back surgery changes his read on Yan vs. Merab 3 this Saturday.
v2.question: Worried for Yan?
